title: A Decade of Learning-Based Control: From Theoretic Foundations to Practical Deployment
abstract: arXiv:2610.29187v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Motivated by ten years of Learning-Based Control Invited Sessions at the IEEE Conference on Decision and Control (CDC), this tutorial paper reviews key advances at the intersection of machine learning and control. We focus on methods that combine the flexibility of machine learning techniques with the structure and theoretical foundations of control to design autonomous systems that are capable, reliable, and safe. We first introduce core notions for establishing stability and safety guarantees, then review approaches that learn dynamics models to improve control under uncertainty, and finally discuss data-driven methods that directly synthesize or learn policies, including reinforcement learning, imitation learning, and Bayesian optimization. We further discuss representative applications and open challenges. The goal is to provide an accessible entry point to the field and to support continued progress toward reliable learning-based

translated_title: 基于学习的控制十年回顾：从理论基础到实际部署
translated_abstract: 受IEEE决策与控制会议（CDC）十年来“基于学习的控制”特邀专题的启发，本教程论文回顾了机器学习与控制交叉领域的关键进展。我们专注于将机器学习技术的灵活性与控制的结构和理论基础相结合的方法，以设计能力强、可靠且安全的自主系统。我们首先介绍了建立稳定性和安全性保证的核心概念，然后回顾了通过学习动力学模型来改善不确定性下控制的方法，最后讨论了直接综合或学习策略的数据驱动方法，包括强化学习、模仿学习和贝叶斯优化。我们进一步讨论了代表性应用和开放挑战。本文的目标是为该领域提供一个易于理解的入门途径，并支持向可靠的基于学习的控制系统持续迈进。
tldr: 本文作为教程论文，受IEEE CDC十年“基于学习的控制”专题启发，系统回顾了机器学习与控制交叉领域的关键进展，涵盖稳定性与安全性保证理论、动力学模型学习方法，以及强化学习、模仿学习和贝叶斯优化等数据驱动策略合成方法及其应用与挑战。
en_tdlr: This tutorial paper, motivated by a decade of Learning-Based Control Invited Sessions at IEEE CDC, systematically reviews key advances at the intersection of machine learning and control, covering stability and safety guarantees, learned dynamics models, and data-driven policy synthesis methods including reinforcement learning, imitation learning, and Bayesian optimization.
